definitions.explanation: Used to ask for the reason or cause of something. Slightly more casual than なぜ.
Used to ask about the method or way to do something.

examples.japanese: どうして{遅|おく}れましたか。
どうして{日本語|にほんご}を{勉強|べんきょう}していますか。
どうしてわからないの?

notes: More conversational than なぜ (why) which is more formal. Often followed by か in questions. Can express surprise or disbelief: どうして?! (Why?!/How come?!). Response typically uses から (because).
